Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.rbi.org.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the BMC post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position is an MBBS degree from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official RBI website and sending the duly filled form along with required documents to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Bank's Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position is Rs. 1000 per hour, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 100,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the RBI BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the BMC position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post involves an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this RBI recruitment is Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) recruitment is strictly offline.
